about.heading: About Us
about.subtitle: Embark on a culinary journey at GERÍCHT, where exquisite flavors and impeccable service intertwine to create an unforgettable dining experience.
about.historyText: In 2012, our head chef Kevin Luo together with a group of friends passionate about cooking, founded GERÍCHT. A modern venue located in the heart of Chicago.
about.story1: Founded in 2012, GERÍCHT was born from a shared passion for exceptional cuisine. Our founder and head chef, Kevin Luo, along with a group of devoted friends, transformed a simple dream into a celebrated fine dining destination.
about.story2: Located in the heart of Chicago, our restaurant combines modern elegance with timeless culinary traditions. Every dish tells a story, every ingredient is carefully selected, and every guest is treated as family.
about.missionText: To create extraordinary dining experiences that linger in memory long after the last bite. We believe in the power of food to bring people together, to celebrate life's moments, and to explore new horizons of flavor.
about.qualityDesc: Only the finest ingredients, prepared with precision and passion.
about.hospitalityDesc: Every guest deserves warmth, attention, and a memorable experience.
about.traditionDesc: Honoring culinary heritage while embracing innovation and creativity.
about.history2012: GERÍCHT opens its doors in the heart of Chicago. Chef Kevin Luo and a small team of passionate individuals bring a dream to life: creating a space where fine dining meets the warmth of home.
about.history2015: The restaurant receives its first Michelin star. The menu expands to include seasonal ingredients and cutting-edge techniques, establishing GERÍCHT as a benchmark in Chicago's culinary scene.
about.history2018: We expand our facilities with a private terrace and a wine cellar featuring over 300 labels. We launch our wine pairing dinners, attracting diners from across the country.
about.history2021: During the pandemic, GERÍCHT reinvents itself with premium delivery service and at-home dining experiences. Our commitment to quality never wavers, even in the toughest times.
about.history2024: Today, GERÍCHT continues to evolve. With a cuisine that honors tradition and embraces innovation, we keep creating unforgettable experiences for every guest who walks through our doors.
about.chefBio: Kevin Luo discovered his passion for cooking at age 12 in his grandmother's kitchen in Shanghai. After training at Le Cordon Bleu and working in some of the world's finest restaurants — from Paris to Tokyo — Kevin decided to create his own culinary destination. In 2012, he founded GERÍCHT with a clear vision: to offer a dining experience that celebrates ingredients, techniques, and above all, people. His philosophy can be summed up in one phrase: 'Cooking is an act of love.'
